heading: ## Kill-rate bands — admission readings (rounds 2–3, measured)
notes: Historical headline assertions agree with the cited measurement notes: kimi 8/10, control 43/43, count held and no inconclusive run (mutation-case-kimi-census.md:20-35); kagi 8/10, control SELFTEST: PASS (16 cases), count held, no inconclusive run and 11.0 s / 11 runs (mutation-case-kagi-census.md:42-56). The kagi record clarifies that 14 cases ran hermetically and two host-gated verb cases were skipped (mutation-case-kagi-census.md:27-38); SKILL.md:369-371 preserves that limitation.

The exact historical source revisions named by the notes were read without executing tests: kumitate 175de6ba2e9e904010411b19cab27e0af9aad3d4 produces sha256 83016d45049b009a6c9868dc392ff6ebcecb357c9abfe423f476459f2724f426; kagi fecee8743e52eb8fb5fbb40782934cb619a1a96e produces sha256 275d8294a94e9eb74caa72043607e9ff12a30414c2d6298a37cbd62ddb53009f. The source anchors cited by the notes match those historical bytes.

All numerical findings are dated historical measurements, not current live-suite results: the section heading identifies rounds 2–3, and the underlying notes record 2026-10-14 runs and source pins. Current sibling paths differ from those historical artifacts (kimi current sha256 7818970b80d4951b8edf15dcc8c5a16efe57f457f956a5ce019f049068538156, 46638 B; kagi current sha256 1e697b0179547a869b73fcf966ce05dd60b07adbe7094a95d3d0a2d4102de11d, 44220 B). No current selftests were run and no current suite count is claimed here.

Non-blocking citation issue at SKILL.md:361: mutation-case-kimi-census.md:74-76 establishes 16 failures for each of D1 and D3 but does not state their 14-case intersection; it points to full lists in scratch evidence. The 14 figure is not false: pinned prior audits record rebuilding the mutants and finding 14 shared (RX9.md:47; CR06.md:97-103; CR09.md:66-68). Re-anchor the citation to retained audit evidence or retain the underlying case lists in the cited record.

Citation precision: SKILL.md:340 cites PROVINCE.md:16-17, but the two-lane rule is at PROVINCE.md:15-16; the cited range misses 'TWO' and includes the next, unrelated sentence. SKILL.md:337 cites kimi note :185-191 for the report-convention/gap statement, but that range is the D7 pre-run calibration miss; the actual headline/table support is :29-35 and :41-53, while the <50% admission anti-claim is plans/round-2.plan.md:8-9. SKILL.md:329's :109-144 supports the protected/not-protected discussion, but its claim about classes outside the injected vocabulary is more directly scoped at kimi note :144-146 (the current range stops before the complete scope statement). These are citation repairs, not false measured expectations.

Obsolete reproduction path caveat: SKILL.md:314-374 itself contains no runnable reproduction command. The cited notes' reproduce blocks copy the current sibling path (kimi note :171-177; kagi note :242-249), which now yields different hashes than their historical pins. A present-day replay must materialize the explicit historical Git revisions and verify the expected hashes; the note's displayed expected hashes make drift detectable. The original /tmp result directories /tmp/tameshi-r2-1-work and /tmp/tameshi-r3-1-work are absent, so their raw result bundles were not inspected and no mutation recipe was rerun.

Round-2 copy-only, unique-replacement, hash-restore and substrate limitations are represented accurately in the notes (kimi :4-7, :22-25, :34-35, :195-207); the kagi host-gated skip and scope limitations are also recorded at :27-38 and :193-206. No blocking gap and no false expectation found in the current section text.
